title: Developer toolkit expanded
text: Cosmic’s internal command tools, diagnostics, and developer controls were expanded and stabilized.

title: Account activity improvements
text: Cosmic now tracks signed-in activity more consistently so personal launch history can power the hub.

title: Cleaner launcher experience
text: The Cosmic hub gained better routing, local profiles, collections, themes, and navigation improvements.

title: Updates feed redesign
text: The updates window was rebuilt as a compact, scrollable feed with individual outlined updates.
